title: PRD-06 synthetic risk input syntax

memberRefs.description: required; 1–100 stable authorized person refs; batch above this. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: MEMBER_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

relationshipCodes.description: required; one carrier-compatible relationship per member. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: RELATIONSHIP_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

birthDates.description: required by rating; valid dates, not future; restricted projection. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: BIRTH_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

baseCoverageRefs.description: conditional by plan; verified evidence and current status. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: BASE_COVERAGE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

healthDeclarationRefs.description: conditional by underwriting; member-specific restricted evidence. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: DECLARATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

benefitPlanCode.description: required; carrier plan version <= 40 code points. Sensitivity: internal. Error: BENEFIT_PLAN_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

networkCode.description: conditional; offered provider-network revision. Sensitivity: internal. Error: NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
